Message:
“Myrlennia, what are you
doing in a place like this?”

as soon as Myrlennia saw me,
a relieved smile
spread across her face.

The flowers dangling from
the tip of her staff
were letting off a faint glow.
Could that be—

“A-About that...
It’s only a slight improvement,
but I’m able to see
some fairies again...”

“That’s incredible...
You really do
have a gift, Myrlennia.
...Compared to you, I’m—”

“Y-You’re the hardest worker
I know, and...and you
always put your all
into everything you do...
I’m proud to call you my friend...!”

“S-So th-this time, it’s my turn...!
I’ll teach you how to see fairies...

B-Because, I want to help...
my friend...!”

With shaking hands,
Myrlennia grabbed hold of mine.

“...Thank you, Myrlennia.
I’m proud to call you
my friend, too.”
